title: Administration Charge Scale on the Settlement of Released Refined Fuels Gallons
content:
One administration charge is taken off the money applied against a booking when gallons are released on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts. How long the account has stood open and how much fuel it has taken over the year decide which charge is taken.

**Where the account has stood open for at least 10 years and the gallons taken on it over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach the programme's minimum annual gallons**, the administration charge is 25.00 USD.

**Where the account has stood open for at least 10 years and those gallons fall under the programme's minimum annual gallons**, the administration charge is 50.00 USD.

**Where the account has stood open for fewer than 10 years**, the administration charge is 75.00 USD.

| Years the account has stood open | Gallons taken in the twelve months ending on the handling date | Administration charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10 or more | At or above the programme's minimum annual gallons | 25.00 USD |
| 10 or more | Below the programme's minimum annual gallons | 50.00 USD |
| Fewer than 10 | Either way | 75.00 USD |

The years are counted from the day the account was opened to the handling date, and the test is met at 10 years exactly. The charge is taken once on the settlement and never per gallon.

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose yearly gallons figure is 1000, an account opened 12 years before the handling date that took 1400.0 gallons in the window bears 25.00 USD. The same account having taken 800.0 gallons bears 50.00 USD. An account opened 6 years before the handling date bears 75.00 USD however many gallons it took.
